# PhoneBridge 0.6.2

## 中文

- Android 安装包改用 release 模式，ARM64 APK 从 0.6.1 的约 107 MB 缩小到约 36.5 MB，沿用原签名，可保留数据覆盖安装。
- 改进手机首页、文件接收页面和连接状态提示；自动重连时不再重复显示错误横幅。
- 接收的文件保存到系统的 Download/PhoneBridge 文件夹，旧版文件会自动迁移。可通过系统文件管理器打开、分享和删除文件。
- 设置中增加存储管理，支持打开文件夹、清理缓存，以及按 7 天、30 天或全部清理已完成的文件。
- 桌面客户端增加系统托盘图标；Windows 和两种 Mac 架构的版本统一为 0.6.2。
- 本次补齐 0.6.2 的正式 GitHub Release 和下载资产；发布流程会验证安装包并同步官网、README、下载二维码和 App 更新信息。

## English

- The Android ARM64 APK is built in release mode and is approximately 36.5 MiB, down from approximately 107 MiB in 0.6.1. It retains the existing preview signing certificate for in-place updates.
- Refined Android home, file inbox and connection status. Reconnect attempts no longer repeat an error banner.
- Received files live in the system Download/PhoneBridge folder. Existing files migrate automatically and can be opened, shared or deleted with the system file manager.
- Storage settings can open the folder, clear cache, and remove completed files older than 7 or 30 days, or all completed files.
- The desktop client gains a system tray icon. Windows, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel packages all report 0.6.2.
- This release publishes the missing 0.6.2 download assets so the verified distribution workflow can update the website, README, QR code and in-app update manifest.
